historical_basis: Eitri, also called Sindri, is a dwarf and Brokkr's brother in Old Norse religion. According to Skáldskaparmál, after Loki had the Sons of Ivaldi make Sif's hair, Freyr's ship Skidbladnir and Odin's spear Gungnir, he bet his head with Brokkr that Eitri could not match their craftsmanship. Eitri began working at his furnace while his brother worked the bellows, but a fly (sometimes thought to be Loki himself) stung Brokkr to stop him and spoil the items. Eitri succeeded in making the golden boar Gullinbursti, the golden ring Draupnir and the hammer Mjöllnir, winning his brother the bet, though its handle was shorter than it should have been.
